control: 64 async graph computations then backend synchronize; no timing events
event: begin on actual backend stream, 64 async graph computations, end on backend stream, backend synchronize, then event elapsed
scope: one contiguous MUL_MAT graph repeated 64 times per batch; direct CUDA backend; one host thread; graphs OFF; hot reused buffers
timing_unit: batch envelope, with derived per-graph amortized time explicitly not a single-kernel latency

correctness.reference: dequantized synthetic weight, double accumulation against original F32 input
correctness.scope: final output after every first/warmup/formal batch, outside timing; intermediate outputs overwritten and not individually checked

quality_gates.cuda_and_ggml_status: all submissions and final sync success; prewait event query permits cudaErrorNotReady
quality_gates.identity: required identities present, full file and loaded native DLL path/hash match, execution pre/post locks pass
quality_gates.event: finite strictly positive batch milliseconds and completed end query
quality_gates.qpc: all boundaries ordered with positive frequency; raw derivations checked
quality_gates.repeats: 30 formal + 5 warmup + 1 first batch per mode; 64 submissions each
quality_gates.numerics: all recorded batches checked; no numerical tolerance increase from v1
quality_gates.validation: K1024 aligned controls predeclared as held-out validation; no threshold selection or fitting

run_order: protocol order; even config index event then control, odd index control then event; one process each
old_failure_retained: v1 validation_Q4_K_m64 first-batch numerical failure remains rejected; not included in v2 reduced M<=4 grid and not claimed fixed
background_load_policy: Known LLM, probe, simulator or hash process blocks start; WDDM compute-apps can list desktop graphics, so retain all listed processes and declare exclusive GPU access unverified; no process is killed; frozen quality gates determine rejection
